steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: grounding
steps.eval: (() => { const ctx = window.__designChatContext(); if (typeof ctx !== 'string' || ctx.length < 200) throw new Error('context too small: ' + String(ctx).slice(0, 100)); const must = ['Living', 'score', 'm²']; for (const m of must) { if (!new RegExp(m, 'i').test(ctx)) throw new Error('context missing "' + m + '": ' + ctx.slice(0, 300)); } window.__ctxLen = ctx.length; return 'grounded, ' + ctx.length + ' chars'; })()
